headline: Techint Group's Tenaris Wins 100,000 Tonne Steel Pipe Contract for Argentina LNG
summary: Tenaris secured an order to produce 100,000 tonnes of steel pipes for the Argentina LNG export pipeline project. The contract follows three previous unsuccessful tender bids by the firm.
why: Tenaris is a leading global supplier of steel tubes and pipeline services for the energy industry.

impacts.name: Tenaris
impacts.why: Securing major steel pipe orders boosts manufacturing volumes and sales revenue for Tenaris.
